prompt: Aerial drone photo of Suwon Hwaseong Fortress in Korea at golden hour, the long stone fortress wall with its gates and pavilions winding over the hill through the city. A 300 meter section of the wall has come alive and is rising off the ground like a stone dragon, arching high above the rooftops, stone blocks and dust falling from its underside, a gate pavilion forming its head, tiny tourists on the remaining wall looking up.

Aerial drone photo of Banpo Bridge over the Han River in Seoul at dusk. The bridge's famous rainbow fountain has turned into a colossal waterfall: a 60 meter tall wall of water pours from the entire length of the bridge into the river like Niagara, rainbow colored light glowing through the falling water, huge mist clouds, tiny people on the riverside park, Seoul skyline and Namsan tower behind.

Aerial drone photo of Naejangsan in Korea in peak autumn. A gigantic tidal wave made entirely of red, orange and yellow maple leaves, 100 meters tall, rolls down the valley and curls over the temple and its traditional pavilion like an ocean wave, leaves spraying from its crest like foam, warm afternoon sunlight glowing through the leaves, tiny hikers on the temple path looking up.

Aerial drone photo above Haneul Park in Seoul at sunset. The silver grass field has become an endless golden sea: enormous slow ocean waves made of glowing pampas grass roll across the entire hilltop and spill over the edge toward the Han River and World Cup Stadium, a small wooden observation deck floating on the grass like a boat, tiny people on it, deep orange and pink sky.

Aerial drone photo of Gacheon Daraengi terraced rice village on the Namhae coast, Korea, at sunset. Every one of the hundred curved rice terraces has become a tier of a giant staircase waterfall, turquoise water cascading from terrace to terrace all the way down the steep slope into the sea, mist and a rainbow, the small village houses on islands between the falls, tiny people on the footpaths, golden light.
